title: Panna Masala
subtitle: A roasted cumin, fennel and black pepper powder that seasons aam, guava and pineapple panna.
protein: A pantry blend — 1 tsp seasons a glass of panna

method.title: Dry roast
items: Dry roast, stirring, until they smell toasty and the cumin turns a shade darker
Tip onto a wide plate and let it cool completely

method.title: Grind and store
items: Once cool, transfer to a grinder jar
Let the powder cool again — grinding warms it
Store in an airtight jar until needed; it keeps about 3 months

method.label: Toddler note
items: This masala is mostly black pepper — keep it out of her glass
In the panna recipes her share is pulled before the green chili, and her glass skips this masala

method.label: Tip
method.text: Used in the aam panna, guava panna and pineapple panna recipes: 1 tsp per glass. It's also good sprinkled over chaas, fruit or lemonade.
